no_active_clinical_pipeline_reason: Eton is a commercial-stage rare-disease specialty pharma. It has eight commercial products (INCRELEX, ALKINDI SPRINKLE, KHINDIVI, GALZIN, PKU GOLIKE, Carglumic Acid, Betaine Anhydrous, Nitisinone) and five late-stage product candidates (ET-600 [NDA filed], Amglidia, ET-700, ET-800, ZENEO hydrocortisone autoinjector). Pipeline is built on 505(b)(2) reformulations, in-licensed assets, and device combinations advancing toward NDA via bridging studies — there are no active company-sponsored Phase 1/2/3 clinical trials registered on ClinicalTrials.gov.
